name: @mesh/system-interface
description: Live system load contract: processor, memory, disk, temperature and network throughput.

state.name: available
state.description: Whether load figures have been sampled

state.name: cpu
state.description: Processor use in percent over the last sample interval

state.name: cpu_history
state.description: Recent processor samples in percent, oldest first

state.name: memory_used
state.description: Used memory in bytes (total minus available)

state.name: disk_used
state.description: Used bytes on the root filesystem

state.name: disk_total
state.description: Size in bytes of the root filesystem

state.name: temperature
state.description: Hottest processor sensor in degrees Celsius; absent when unknown

state.name: net_rx
state.description: Received bytes per second, all non-loopback interfaces

state.name: net_tx
state.description: Sent bytes per second, all non-loopback interfaces
